Name: Nyapu Style Portraits for Dead Boy Detectives
Author: Howaa
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Portraits for The Dead Boy Detectives Characters using Nyapu's style as a base.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This is a file replacement mod! So you'll need to navigate to your mod folder, find Dead Boy Detectives, and drag my "assets" folder into the Dead Boy Detectives mod folder, allow my portraits to overwrite the originals, and you're done! [/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI, Dead Boy Detectives [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68019645]handwrittenhello[/url]  for Dead Boy Detectives, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for their portraits & generous permissions & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/118430843]nugmods[/url] for their Eli & Dylan portraits, I don't think I would have figured out how to make a convincingly Nyapu style crow without having their art as a reference! 

Mods used in the cover image - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23647]Shane UI[/url] (slightly recolored by me for a personal edit) & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42851]Seasonal Portrait Backgrounds[/url]
